title: Algorithmic Amplification of Politics on Twitter
reasoning: The paper focuses on the algorithmic amplification of political content and news sources on Twitter using a large-scale randomized experiment. It does not contain an evaluation or benchmark related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics; the 'Ethical Approval' section provided in the supplementary information pertains to the procedural ethics of conducting the research study rather than being a thematic component of the analysis.
